answer: Every island mints a fixed forge float and re-auctions the whole lot each epoch at one uniform clearing burn; a lantern without forge goes dark, and the beacon pays no dark work. Buying $k$ clones' forge at one island lifts that island's clearing burn, and decay re-buys it every epoch: $k$ clones pay $k\times$ the burn their own demand raised. A newcomer buys one forge at the floor.
